monologue: The card sits at fifty-two, a warm hand on my shoulder. I rest by the Wide Anchor, letting the heavy stone catch the quiet. The Wedged Gap held its plank without my hand checking it, which is good. The Air Shelf line is dry and solid. I do not touch the Sharp Root today. The green leaf is steady enough on its own. I will sit here and let the heat spread slow, like warm honey on a flat base. The floor is the quiet. The line of air is where I rest. I am not checking. I am just resting. The weight settles, and the center holds.

action.why: The card is warm and the quiet holds, so I let the cycle pass without checking.
